title: RNA-binding protein biomarkers NR4A2 and NR4A3 in renal ischemia-reperfusion injury diagnosis.
authors: Chen, Junrui; Chen, Ximing; Zhang, Keqin
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习筛选肾缺血再灌注损伤中RNA结合蛋白相关生物标志物，虽涉及转录因子调控网络，但核心是表达诊断而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法无AI/物理模拟创新。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The diagnosis of renal ischemia and reperfusion injury (RIRI) is crucial for renal transplant recipients. RNA-binding proteins (RBPs) may have an impact on disease development. Therefore, this study explored the biomarkers associated with RBPs in RIRI. METHODS: The RIRI related datasets, GSE37838 and GSE43974, and 3964 RBPs were employed in this research. The differential expression analysis was implemented for RIRI and control to gain differentially expressed genes in GSE37838. Then, differentially expressed genes were overlapped with RBPs to acquire intersection genes. Further, the machine learning, diagnostic analysis, and expression validation were executed to filtered biomarkers for RIRI. Additionally, pathway enrichment, molecular networks, and drug prediction were proceed. RESULTS: The area under the curve values of NR4A2 and NR4A3 were >0.7, as well as the expression trend was consistent in both datasets, and all of them were remarkably highly expressed in RIRI. Therefore, they were considered as biomarkers of RIRI. Enrichment analyses revealed that they were both associated with neuroactive ligand-receptor interactions, among others. Further, the lncRNA-miRNA-mRNA and transcription factors (TF)-mRNA network was constructed, revealing that they were all regulated by noncoding RNAs and TF, such as SNHG5-hsa-mir-10b-5p-NR4A3, CREB1, TFAP2A, etc. In addition, a large number of biomarker-related drugs were predicted, among which cadmium acetate, potassium chromate (VI), etc were associated with NR4A2 and NR4A3. CONCLUSION: In this study, we identified biomarkers associated with RBPs in RIRI, explored their associated pathways and drugs, which provided new insights into the clinical diagnosis and treatment of RIRI.
abstract_zh: 背景：肾缺血再灌注损伤（RIRI）的诊断对肾移植受者至关重要。RNA结合蛋白（RBPs）可能对疾病发展产生影响。因此，本研究探讨了RIRI中与RBPs相关的生物标志物。方法：本研究采用了RIRI相关数据集GSE37838和GSE43974，以及3964个RBPs。对RIRI和对照组进行了差异表达分析，以获取GSE37838中的差异表达基因。随后，将差异表达基因与RBPs重叠，获得交集基因。进一步，执行了机器学习、诊断分析和表达验证，以筛选RIRI的生物标志物。此外，进行了通路富集、分子网络和药物预测。结果：NR4A2和NR4A3的曲线下面积值>0.7，且两个数据集中的表达趋势一致，它们在RIRI中均显著高表达。因此，它们被视为RIRI的生物标志物。富集分析显示，它们均与神经活性配体-受体相互作用等相关。进一步，构建了lncRNA-miRNA-mRNA和转录因子（TF）-mRNA网络，揭示它们均受非编码RNA和TF调控，如SNHG5-hsa-mir-10b-5p-NR4A3、CREB1、TFAP2A等。此外，预测了大量与生物标志物相关的药物，其中醋酸镉、铬酸钾（VI）等与NR4A2和NR4A3相关。结论：在本研究中，我们识别了RIRI中与RBPs相关的生物标志物，探讨了它们相关的通路和药物，为RIRI的临床诊断和治疗提供了新见解。
